description: This file implements the ClientController class for the Rialto client, managing application state, shared memory, and client registration within the Rialto media framework.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Manages client registration, application state, and shared memory for the Rialto client.

classes.name: IClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Interface providing access to the singleton instance of ClientController.

classes.name: ClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Implementation of IClientControllerAccessor, providing singleton access to ClientController.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IClientControllerAccessor.

methods.name: ClientController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ClientController, setting up IPC and registering the client.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and retrieves the current application state.

methods.name: initSharedMemory
methods.description: Initializes shared memory for the client.

methods.name: termSharedMemory
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up shared memory.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Updates and notifies clients of application state changes.

methods.name: changeStateAndNotifyClients
methods.description: Changes application state and notifies all registered clients.
